content.study:
Section 43A — Definitions

Section 43A defines key expressions used in Part IA, including Chairperson, Council and Member of the Arbitration Council of India.

Part IA provisions concerning the Arbitration Council of India must be read with the commencement and implementation status of the relevant provisions and subordinate legislation.

sections.heading: Implementation check
sections.body: Before relying on an institutional provision in litigation or advice, verify whether the relevant Part IA provision has been brought into force and what subordinate legislation or notification applies.

misconceptions.correction: Check commencement and implementation status before relying on the institutional provision.
